with snapshots as (

    select
        r.file_name,
        r.file_last_modified                              as polled_at,
        s.value                                           as st
    from DIVVY.RAW.station_status_raw r,
         lateral flatten(input => r.raw:data:stations) s
    

),

parsed as (

    select
        st:station_id::string                             as station_id,
        to_timestamp_ntz(st:last_reported::int)           as last_reported_at,
        polled_at,
        file_name,

        st:num_bikes_available::int                       as bikes_available,
        st:num_ebikes_available::int                      as ebikes_available,
        st:num_bikes_disabled::int                        as bikes_disabled,
        st:num_docks_available::int                       as docks_available,
        st:num_docks_disabled::int                        as docks_disabled,

        coalesce(st:is_installed::int, 1) = 1             as is_installed,
        coalesce(st:is_renting::int,   1) = 1             as is_renting,
        coalesce(st:is_returning::int, 1) = 1             as is_returning

        from snapshots
    where st:station_id is not null
      and st:last_reported is not null
      -- some stations report a placeholder time (1970) before going live
      and to_timestamp_ntz(st:last_reported::int) >= '2020-01-01'

)

select *
from parsed
-- keep the first poll that saw each distinct station report
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by station_id, last_reported_at
    order by polled_at
) = 1

select last_reported_at
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
where last_reported_at is null

select bikes_available
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
where bikes_available is null

select *
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
where bikes_available < 0
   or docks_available < 0
   or coalesce(ebikes_available, 0) < 0
   or coalesce(bikes_disabled, 0) < 0
   or coalesce(docks_disabled, 0) < 0

select station_id
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
where station_id is null

select docks_available
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
where docks_available is null

select polled_at
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
where polled_at is null

select station_id, last_reported_at, count(*) as n
from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status
group by station_id, last_reported_at
having count(*) > 1

with status as (

    select * from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_status

),

info as (

    select station_id, capacity, is_rack_or_corral
    from DIVVY.DEV_staging.stg_station_information

),

latest_poll as (

    select max(polled_at) as max_polled_at from status

),

ordered as (

    select
        s.station_id,
        s.last_reported_at                                            as valid_from,
        lead(s.last_reported_at) over (
            partition by s.station_id order by s.last_reported_at)    as next_report_at,
        s.bikes_available,
        s.ebikes_available,
        s.bikes_disabled,
        s.docks_available,
        s.docks_disabled,
        s.is_installed,
        s.is_renting,
        s.is_returning,
        i.capacity,
        coalesce(i.is_rack_or_corral, false)                          as is_rack_or_corral
    from status s
    left join info i on s.station_id = i.station_id

),

with_end as (

    select
        o.*,
        coalesce(o.next_report_at, lp.max_polled_at)                  as valid_to,
        o.next_report_at is null                                      as is_current
    from ordered o
    cross join latest_poll lp

)

select
    station_id,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    datediff('second', valid_from, valid_to) / 60.0                   as duration_min,
    date_trunc('hour', valid_from)                                    as hour_utc,
    bikes_available,
    ebikes_available,
    bikes_disabled,
    docks_available,
    docks_disabled,
    capacity,
    is_installed,
    is_renting,
    is_returning,
    is_rack_or_corral,
    is_current,
    datediff('second', valid_from, valid_to) / 60.0
        > 30                                  as is_stale,
    case
        when not is_installed or (not is_renting and not is_returning) then 'out_of_service'
        when bikes_available = 0 and is_renting                        then 'empty'
        when docks_available = 0 and is_returning                      then 'full'
        else 'ok'
    end                                                               as station_state
from with_end

select station_id
from DIVVY.DEV_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
where station_id is null

with all_values as (

    select
        station_state as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from DIVVY.DEV_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    group by station_state

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'empty','full','ok','out_of_service'
)

with intervals as (

    select station_id, valid_from, bikes_available, hour_utc
    from DIVVY.DEV_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where not is_rack_or_corral
      and station_state <> 'out_of_service'

),

changes as (

    select
        station_id,
        lag(valid_from) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from)      as window_start,
        valid_from                                                              as window_end,
        hour_utc,
        bikes_available
          - lag(bikes_available) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from) as bike_change
    from intervals

)

select
    md5(station_id || '|' || to_varchar(window_end))                 as rebalancing_event_id,
    station_id,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    hour_utc,
    datediff('second', window_start, window_end) / 60.0              as window_min,
    bike_change,
    iff(bike_change > 0, 'drop_off', 'pick_up')                      as event_type
from changes
where window_start is not null
  and abs(bike_change) >= 5
  and datediff('second', window_start, window_end) / 60.0 <= 10

select rebalancing_event_id
from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_rebalancing_events
where rebalancing_event_id is null

select
    rebalancing_event_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_rebalancing_events
where rebalancing_event_id is not null
group by rebalancing_event_id
having count(*) > 1

with child as (
    select station_id as from_field
    from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_rebalancing_events
    where station_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select station_id as to_field
    from DIVVY.DEV_marts.dim_station
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

with intervals as (

    select *
    from DIVVY.DEV_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where not is_rack_or_corral

),

marked as (

    select
        *,
        case
            when station_state = lag(station_state) over (
                     partition by station_id order by valid_from)
            then 0 else 1
        end                                                          as is_new_island
    from intervals

),

islands as (

    select
        *,
        sum(is_new_island) over (
            partition by station_id order by valid_from
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row)        as island_id
    from marked

),

episodes as (

    select
        station_id,
        island_id,
        station_state                                                as stockout_type,
        min(valid_from)                                              as started_at,
        max(valid_to)                                                as ended_at,
        boolor_agg(is_current)                                       as is_ongoing,
        boolor_agg(is_stale)                                         as includes_stale_report,
        count(*)                                                     as report_count
    from islands
    where station_state in ('empty', 'full')
    group by station_id, island_id, station_state

)

select
    md5(station_id || '|' || stockout_type || '|' || to_varchar(started_at)) as stockout_event_id,
    station_id,
    stockout_type,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    datediff('second', started_at, ended_at) / 60.0                  as duration_min,
    date_trunc('hour', started_at)                                   as hour_utc,
    is_ongoing,
    includes_stale_report,
    report_count
from episodes
where datediff('second', started_at, ended_at) / 60.0 >= 5

select stockout_event_id
from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_stockout_events
where stockout_event_id is null

select *
from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_stockout_events
where ended_at <= started_at

with all_values as (

    select
        stockout_type as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_stockout_events
    group by stockout_type

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'empty','full'
)

select
    stockout_event_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_stockout_events
where stockout_event_id is not null
group by stockout_event_id
having count(*) > 1

with child as (
    select station_id as from_field
    from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_stockout_events
    where station_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select station_id as to_field
    from DIVVY.DEV_marts.dim_station
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    md5(station_id || '|' || to_varchar(valid_from))             as snapshot_id,
    station_id,
    hour_utc,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    duration_min,
    bikes_available,
    ebikes_available,
    bikes_disabled,
    docks_available,
    docks_disabled,
    capacity,
    station_state,
    is_stale,
    is_current,
    is_rack_or_corral
from DIVVY.DEV_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals

select snapshot_id
from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_station_snapshots
where snapshot_id is null

select station_id
from DIVVY.DEV_marts.fct_station_snapshots
where station_id is null
